ra: The Discordian Eris is the central deity of the Discordianism tradition-hub.
The Sacred Chao is a core Discordian symbol belonging to the tradition.
The Golden Apple is a foundational Discordian relic belonging to the tradition.
Greyface is a Discordian mythic figure belonging to the tradition.
The Law of Fives is a core doctrine belonging to the Discordian tradition.

The Discordian Goddess of Chaos is an explicit modern reception/re-imagining of the ancient Greek Eris (ENT_ERIS), the founding act of Discordian invention per the Principia Discordia and Cusack 2010.
In Discordian cosmology Eris reveals/governs the Sacred Chao as the emblem of her ordered-and-chaotic cosmos.
The Sacred Chao is the central emblem of the Discordian Eris and her doctrine of the chaos/order interplay.
The kallisti-inscribed Golden Apple is Eris's defining emblem in both the Greek myth and Discordian practice.
Greyface, the spirit of grim order, is the doctrinal antagonist of the chaos-goddess Eris in Discordian myth.
